pkgmetadata.longdescription: Ironwail is a fork of the QuakeSpasm Quake engine focused on high performance: culling and lightmap updates run on the GPU (OpenGL 4.3 compute shaders), and the renderer is decoupled from the server. It adds a Mods menu, mouse-driven menus, Q64-style HUDs, real-time palettization and plays the 2021 re-release content with no setup.

use.flag: Download add-ons of the 2021 re-release through net-misc/curl
